items.title: Godfrey Hirsch Interview, 1987-10-27
items.q: And then, Bobby Castigliola's father was there for a while

ctx.x: I played drums, yeah. And, uh, did you play any piano, Jose? We had quite a conglomeration of musicians there. Ray Bonitas was playing, he was playing string bass, we had a player, we had a bass player by the name of Finats. Yeah. An Italian player, Finats.
